```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"
library(broom)
library(tibble)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
league_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "laser_league_players.csv"))
model_lm <- lm(season_score ~ matches_played + assists + tag_accuracy_pct + shield_uptime_pct, data = league_df)
summary(model_lm)
```

```{r}
coef_table <- broom::tidy(model_lm) %>%
  select(term, estimate, p.value)
coef_table
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_lm)
```

```{r}
new_profiles <- tibble(
  matches_played = c(10, 30),
  assists = c(8, 20),
  tag_accuracy_pct = c(45, 62),
  shield_uptime_pct = c(55, 80)
)
predictions <- predict(model_lm, newdata = new_profiles)
predictions
```
